news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Man City press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在曼城赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our huge Women's Super League clash against Manchester City on Saturday, and here are the main talking points from what the Blues head coach said. Bompastor answered the assembled journalists' questions about the game, in which the top two teams in the WSL prepare to face off for the first time this season - with just a couple of points separating the sides. The head coach reported that Lauren James and Naomi Girma will be unavailable until the conclusion of this block of fixtures next weekend, prior to the forthcoming international break. And here are the rest of the key talking points from our head coach’s pre-match press conference on Friday as she looked ahead to a mouthwatering contest. ‘From what you could see from the beginning of the season, probably both teams will want to win the game, and both teams will attack to win the game. ‘Probably you will see goals tomorrow, hopefully for everyone, and not too much for us in terms of conceding! ‘It’s never easy to play teams who are sitting in the low block and not really allowing you to find spaces. I think this game will be different, for sure, in terms of space on the pitch. We need to be smart to recognise that and exploit it.’ ‘The two last results have been frustrating for us, so it's good to see from the players' reaction, but also the staff reaction, that we are hungry. ‘We have hunger going into the game tomorrow. We need to keep working, and I'm convinced we'll create opportunities, and we need to make sure we are clinical. ‘Many things can happen when you are in those moments, and we keep working on the pitch, providing details to the players, reviewing the games, trying to understand what we can do even better to make sure we are able to score in every game.’ ‘She's been really good. She's a player who is able to defend but also to attack, as you could see this season. ‘She’s able to run through that outside corridor. She has improved a lot in terms of the quality of her crossing, but also when she gets in the box, the decision-making on the ball. ‘She's scored some great goals and she's making an impact for us. Even if sometimes people think she can be predictable in what she's doing, she's still really good at doing what she does.’ ‘If we go focus too much on her, another player from Man City will find a way maybe to create and score a goal. We know that because they have a lot of quality as a team, but also they have a lot of great individuals. ‘We believe in the quality of the players we have on the pitch as well. We believe in what we are doing as a team also to defend, especially in the box. We proved that already when we played against Arsenal, when we played against Lyon in the Champions League. ‘We were able to not concede much during those games, we took some learnings, and we'll try to apply the same for the game tomorrow.’ ‘In that game, the mental aspects were the most important ones. When you are leading at home by two goals and you have 15 minutes left in the game, I think you can't let the game go the way it went. ‘But it happens. We took the learnings, and what we know from that game and the quality City has on their side, from minute one until the end of the game they have the opportunity to be a good team and to score at any time. ‘So obviously we know we will have to be a good team from minute one until the end of the game, and make sure we are really switched on.’ See the Blues in action against Man City at Stamford Bridge! Tickets are available here...
news.body_zh: 在周六对阵曼城的女超联赛之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯特在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的主要谈话要点。庞帕斯特回答了现场记者关于这场比赛的问题，这场比赛是 WSL 两支顶级球队准备在本赛季首次交锋的比赛，双方的积分差距仅几分。主教练报告说，劳伦·詹姆斯和娜奥米·吉尔玛将无法上场，直到下周末即即将到来的国际比赛日之前这一系列比赛结束。以下是我们主教练周五赛前新闻发布会上的其余关键谈话要点，她展望了一场令人垂涎的比赛。 “从赛季初的情况来看，两支球队可能都想赢得比赛，并且都会进攻以赢得比赛。 “明天你可能会看到进球，希望每个人都能进球，而我们的失球也不会太多！ “与那些坐在低位、不允许你找到空间的球队比赛从来都不是一件容易的事。我认为这场比赛在球场空间方面肯定会有所不同。我们需要聪明地认识到这一点并利用它。” “最后两个结果让我们感到沮丧，所以很高兴从球员的反应和工作人员的反应中看到我们很饥饿。 “我们对明天的比赛充满渴望。我们需要继续努力，我相信我们会创造机会，我们需要确保我们是临床的。 “当你处于那种时刻时，很多事情都会发生，我们会继续在球场上努力，向球员提供细节，回顾比赛，试图了解我们可以做得更好，以确保我们能够在每场比赛中进球。”她是一位既能防守又能进攻的球员，正如你在本赛季看到的那样。 “她能够跑过外面的走廊。她的传中质量有了很大提高，而且当她进入禁区时，她的控球决策也有了很大提高。 “她打进了一些伟大的进球，她正在对我们产生影响。 “即使有时人们认为她可以预测她所做的事情，但她仍然非常擅长做她所做的事情。” “如果我们过多关注她，来自曼城的另一名球员也许会找到一种方法来创造并进球。我们知道这一点，因为他们作为一个团队具有很高的素质，而且他们也有很多优秀的个人。 `我们也相信场上球员的素质。我们相信我们作为一个团队所做的事情以及防守，尤其是在禁区内。当我们对阵阿森纳时，当我们在冠军联赛中对阵里昂时，我们已经证明了这一点。 “我们在那些比赛中没有丢太多球，我们学到了一些东西，我们会尝试在明天的比赛中应用同样的东西。” “在那场比赛中，心理方面是最重要的。”当你在主场领先两球并且比赛还剩15分钟时，我认为你不能让比赛继续这样发展。 ‘但它确实发生了。我们吸取了教训，从那场比赛中学到了知识，以及曼城的实力，从第一分钟到比赛结束，他们都有机会成为一支优秀的球队，并随时得分。 “所以显然我们知道我们必须从第一分钟到比赛结束都是一支优秀的球队，并确保我们真正处于状态。”观看蓝军在斯坦福桥对阵曼城的比赛！门票可以在这里购买...

news.title: Sonia Bompastor named WSL Manager of the Month
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 被评为 WSL 月度最佳经理
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has been named Women's Super League Manager of the Month after guiding the Blues to three victories from our three league matches in October. Bompastor's side enjoyed a perfect October in the WSL, netting 12 goals and conceding just three as we maintained our unbeaten start to the campaign. The month began with an impressive 3-0 win away at West Ham United, before the Blues returned to Stamford Bridge following the international break to secure a thrilling 6-2 victory over London rivals Tottenham Hotspur. That derby triumph marked Bompastor's 50th WSL match in charge of Chelsea, with the Blues head coach setting a new WSL record of 125 points from her opening 50 games. In our final league fixture of October, we came from behind to claim a 3-1 victory over Crystal Palace, with Melvine Malard scoring twice in the second half to secure all three points. It is the fifth time Bompastor has received the WSL Manager of the Month award since taking charge in the summer of 2024.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 带领蓝军在 10 月份的三场联赛中取得三场胜利，被评为本月女超联赛最佳主教练。邦帕斯托的球队在 ​​WSL 中度过了一个完美的 10 月份，攻入 12 个进球，仅丢 3 个球，保持了赛季不败的开局。这个月伊始，蓝军客场3-0战胜西汉姆联队，随后蓝军在国际比赛日后回到斯坦福桥，以6-2惊心动魄地击败伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。这场德比的胜利标志着邦帕斯托执教切尔西的第 50 场 WSL 比赛，这位蓝军主教练在她的前 50 场比赛中创造了新的 WSL 记录，即 125 分。在十月份的最后一场联赛中，我们后来居上，以 3-1 战胜水晶宫，梅尔文·马拉德在下半场梅开二度，全取三分。这是 Bompastor 自 2024 年夏天上任以来第五次获得 WSL 月度最佳经理奖。

news.title: Bompastor updates on James and Girma availability ahead of Man City
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯特在曼城之前更新了詹姆斯和吉尔马的可用情况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor confirmed that Lauren James and Naomi Girma are progressing well on their return from injury, but she expects our next match against Manchester City to be too soon for them to be involved. Chelsea face a huge Women’s Super League fixture on Saturday, when we host Manchester City at Stamford Bridge in a top-of-the-table clash. After dropping WSL points for the first time since our opening game of the season, we now sit two points behind leaders Man City, but can retake first place with a home win this weekend. However, the Blues will have to do so without the help of James or Girma, after our manager gave an update on the progress of their recovery from injury. ‘I think LJ is good, but I don’t think we expect to see her in this block,’ said Bompastor, in her pre-match press conference on Friday afternoon. ‘That’s the same for Nay. She’s now more in advance, not far from starting again to train with the team. ‘So both of them are doing good, but we won’t see them in this block with us.’ Even without those two, Bompastor still has plenty of talent at her disposal for this massive WSL fixture, and is confident her team has what it takes to secure what could be a crucial victory in the title race in front of our home support at the Bridge. ‘In terms of that the two teams are unbeaten, it is an important game between two teams that are performing at a really good level, but not the only ones obviously. ‘I think tomorrow it’s a game worth three points, like the other ones, but in terms of the psychological aspects, the team that is able to win will take maybe a psychological advantage. ‘So we are playing at home and we approach every game the same, tomorrow won’t be different. We want to come to the game and bring some confidence, but also try to win the game. I know we have the ability to do that so we will try our best. ‘The game plan is ready. We’ve only had a few training sessions after the Hacken game, but I feel the team is in a good place and ready for the game tomorrow.’ Secure your seat at the Bridge to cheer the team on against Man City! Tickets are still available.
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特证实劳伦·詹姆斯和娜奥米·吉尔玛伤愈复出后进展顺利，但她预计我们下一场对阵曼城的比赛对他们来说还为时过早。周六，切尔西将面临一场重要的女足超级联赛比赛，届时我们将在斯坦福桥迎战曼城，这是一场积分榜榜首的比赛。自赛季首场比赛以来，WSL 积分首次下降，目前我们落后领头羊曼城两分，但本周末可以通过主场胜利重新夺回第一名。然而，在我们的主教练通报了伤病恢复进展的最新情况后，蓝军将不得不在没有詹姆斯或吉尔马帮助的情况下做到这一点。 “我认为 LJ 很好，但我认为我们不会期望在这个街区看到她，”邦帕斯特在周五下午的赛前新闻发布会上说道。 '对奈来说也是如此。她现在已经提前了很多，距离重新开始和球队一起训练已经不远了。 “所以他们俩都做得很好，但我们不会看到他们和我们一起出现在这个街区。”即使没有这两个人，邦帕斯特仍然有足够的天赋来参加这场大规模的 WSL 比赛，并且相信她的球队有能力在我们桥牌主场的支持者面前确保在冠军争夺战中取得关键的胜利。 “就两队不败而言，这是两支表现非常出色的球队之间的一场重要比赛，但显然不是唯一的比赛。 “我认为明天的比赛和其他比赛一样，是一场值得三分的比赛，但从心理方面来说，能够获胜的球队可能会占据心理优势。 “所以我们是在主场比赛，我们对待每场比赛都是一样的，明天不会有什么不同。我们希望来到比赛中并带来一些信心，同时也努力赢得比赛。我知道我们有能力做到这一点，所以我们会尽力而为。 ‘比赛计划已经准备好了。在与哈肯的比赛后，我们只进行了几次训练，但我觉得球队状态良好，为明天的比赛做好了准备。” 在桥上预留座位，为球队对阵曼城的比赛加油！门票仍然有售。

news.title: Favourite late winners: The quarter-final results!
news.title_zh: 最喜欢的迟到冠军：四分之一决赛结果！
news.body_en: We can now reveal which four memorable Chelsea late winning goals have advanced to the semi-finals in our vote held on the Chelsea Official App. We asked supporters to choose their favourite late Premier League winner at Stamford Bridge in four separate pairings. The first to progress was William Gallas, whose spectacular strike against Tottenham edged out his compatriot Frank Leboeuf with 67 per cent of the vote. It was more clear cut in the second quarter-final, where Estevao's winner against Liverpool last season triumphed with an 89 per cent share over the vote, beating Claude Makelele's goal on the day we lifted the Premier League title for the first time. Our third semi-finalist is Frank Lampard, who sparked pandemonium at the Bridge when he completed a late comeback against Stoke in 2009. That received 61 per cent of the vote when paired with Willian's decider in a 1-0 win over Everton six years later. Cole Palmer also advanced, with his late, late deflected strike in the 4-3 epic with Manchester United two-and-a-half years ago. He beat off competition from Fernando Torres, who settled a top-of-the-table clash against Manchester City in 2013. Make sure to return tomorrow (Saturday) to cast your vote in the semi-finals!

news.title: Mike Penders save voted Premier League’s best
news.title_zh: 迈克·潘德斯扑救被评选为英超最佳扑救
news.body_en: Mike Penders has received the Premier League Save of the Month award for October for his stunning stop against Manchester United. The Blues goalkeeper had competition from five others on the shortlist, but the public vote picked Penders’ save as the best in the Premier League during October. The save which claimed the award came late in our 2-0 win over Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, just one week after the 21-year-old’s full league debut. He showed quick reflexes and excellent agility to divert Bryan Mbeumo’s powerful drive onto the crossbar with his fingertips, keeping his clean sheet intact. It wasn’t just the Premier League supporters casting their vote for the award who were so impressed by the Belgian’s reflexes, as he admitted that even some of his team-mates found it almost too good to believe. ‘The ball came so quickly, I didn’t even see it properly,’ said Penders on his award-winning stop. ‘It was just instinct, pure instinct, a reaction. I felt a good touch on my fingertips and, after that moment, I screamed all the positive emotions out. I had to, I was so happy with that moment. ‘Then, after the game, no-one believed me that I touched it! I was like: “Yeah, I touched it, you will see afterwards”. ‘Then it was pretty quickly on Twitter. A team-mate came into the dressing room saying: “He touched it”. I was very happy it was a good angle, because if the angle wasn't right, they could still have some doubts!’ Penders becomes the third Chelsea goalkeeper to receive the Premier League Save of the Month award since it was introduced for the start of the 2022/23 season, following Kepa Arrizabalaga and Robert Sanchez (twice).
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯因对阵曼联的精彩扑救而荣获十月份英超联赛最佳扑救奖。这位蓝军门将与入围名单上的其他五名门将展开竞争，但公众投票认为彭德斯的扑救是十月份英超联赛中最好的扑救。获得该奖项的扑救发生在我们在斯坦福桥2-0战胜曼联的比赛中，距离这位21岁的球员完成联赛首秀仅一周后。他表现出快速的反应和出色的敏捷性，用指尖将布莱恩·姆博莫的强力射门转移到横梁上，保持了不失球。比利时人的反应给这个奖项留下了深刻的印象，不仅是英超联赛的支持者投票支持了这一奖项，他也承认，就连他的一些队友也觉得这个奖项好得令人难以置信。 “球来得太快了，我什至没有看清它，”潘德斯在他获奖的停球中说道。 “这只是本能，纯粹的本能，一种反应。我感觉到指尖有一种很好的触感，在那一刻之后，我尖叫出了所有积极的情绪。我必须这样做，那一刻我感到非常高兴。 ‘然后，比赛结束后，没有人相信我碰过它！我当时想：“是的，我摸过它，之后你就会看到”。 “然后这件事很快就在推特上流传开来。一名队友走进更衣室说：“他碰了它”。我很高兴这是一个很好的角度，因为如果角度不对，他们仍然可能会有一些疑问！”潘德斯成为继凯帕·阿里扎巴拉加和罗伯特·桑切斯（两次）之后，自 2022/23 赛季开始以来第三位获得英超月度最佳扑救奖的切尔西门将。

news.title: Cuthbert on heavyweight Man City clash and 'pivotal' fans' support
news.title_zh: 卡斯伯特谈重量级曼城冲突和“关键”球迷的支持
news.body_en: Erin Cuthbert thinks two of the best sides in women's football will make 'punch after punch' when we face off against Manchester City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday. After winning the Women's Super League last season, Man City head coach Andree Jeglertz has guided them to the top of the table once again this season, but the Blues are chasing hard and sit just two points behind after nine games. Saturday's match couldn't be more finely poised, and when we sat down with our captain Erin Cuthbert, she explained exactly why our fans could be the difference-maker in a match where winning and losing will come down to such fine margins. 'The Stamford Bridge crowd have really excelled in the tough moments this season,' said the skipper. 'There have been times when we've been up against it, but that's when the crowd have got us out of that and swung the momentum back in our favour. 'We’re going to need them against Man City because we're not always going to get it our way. The crowd is going to be really pivotal on Saturday. We feed off their energy. We've needed them at times this season, because it hasn't always been plain sailing, despite how many goals we’ve scored and clean sheets we’ve earned. 'Neither side will play for a point; we’ll both be going for the three points, and hopefully that should see the fans turn out in numbers, because they're going to see a game that both sides want to win right until the very end. 'I expect it to be a very high-quality game, but also to be quite edgy at the same time, because both teams want to win, but both teams don't want to lose. So it's a fine balance between whether you go and risk it all, or hold on to what you've got. I know the team will go for it right until the final whistle, and if we're still in it, we'll be going gung-ho, and if we are winning, we'll fight to keep it that way.' Erin Cuthbert is well used to winning silverware at Chelsea. Joining the club in 2016, she only missed out on our first two trophies, and has lifted 18 since then. The Scotland international was a key member of the side that won six consecutive WSL titles before Man City's success last year, and she's determined to see it back in our hands at the end of the campaign. 'It was our trophy for six years before last season, so of course it feels like it's been taken away,' she explains. 'But Man City were rightful winners last year and beat us comfortably in the end. 'There is a degree of wanting to claim what's ours, because it had been ours for so long, but nobody has any given right to the title. It's built through hard work and grinding out wins, good, bad and ugly, across the season, and we're going to need that. 'We know Man City have it just now, so we have to do everything and more. I've been in the position where we've been top of the table, and we've won the league, so I know what it feels like when teams are chasing you. You feel them breathing down your neck. They're coming for you. You feel that in every game. 'It’s a bit different to be the ones chasing. We're part of the chasing pack now, so it's certainly a different mentality, and you're seeing something maybe a bit different this year: that we're so hungry for it.' Those watching will be in for a treat on Saturday, as the Bridge will showcase the very best of what the WSL has to offer as the top two sides battle it out for the three points. If Man City come out to attack, they could break the trend of visiting sides sitting deep in a low block, and that would give our forwards the space to show what they can do. And although for Cuthbert it is just another opportunity to earn three points, another part of her feels that winning the game will make a big statement about our intentions this season. 'Both teams know the quality each other has got at both ends of the pitch,' the captain continues. 'Man City have a very certain style of play. They're not going to sit back and just take pressure from us all game. They're going to come out fighting, and they have really good technical players who can hurt us, but equally we have those players too. It's going to be punch after punch from both sides. 'Their attacking intent could leave spaces that we might not always have in the league, and it opens up a different type of play for a couple of our players in the team to shine. So it's certainly an exciting one, but also one where we're probably going to be a little bit busier defensively, and we expect that. 'It’s something that the team's ready for, because I think defensively we've done really well this season, and I think big credit goes to the backline and everybody else because the job's been monumental so far.' Answer Erin's call to action and secure your seat at the Bridge to cheer the team on against Man City! Tickets are available here.
news.body_zh: 艾琳·库斯伯特认为，周六我们在斯坦福桥对阵曼城时，女足最好的两支球队将“一拳接着一拳”。上赛季夺得女超联赛冠军后，曼城主教练安德烈·耶格勒茨本赛季带领曼城再次登上积分榜榜首，但蓝军紧追不舍，在九场比赛后仅落后两分。周六的比赛保持着完美的平衡，当我们与队长艾琳·卡斯伯特坐下来时，她准确地解释了为什么我们的球迷可以在一场胜负如此微弱的比赛中发挥重要作用。 “斯坦福桥球迷在本赛季的艰难时刻确实表现出色，”队长说道。 “有时候我们会遇到困难，但那是观众让我们摆脱困境并将势头重新转向对我们有利的时候。 “我们在对阵曼城的比赛中需要他们，因为我们并不总是能如愿以偿。周六的人群将会非常关键。我们以他们的能量为食。本赛季我们有时需要他们，因为尽管我们打进了多少球并赢得了多少零封，但事情并不总是一帆风顺。 “双方都不会为了一分而战；我们都会争取三分，希望这能看到球迷的数量，因为他们将看到一场双方都希望赢得比赛直到最后一刻的比赛。 “我希望这将是一场非常高质量的比赛，但同时也会非常紧张，因为两支球队都想赢，但两支球队都不想输。因此，要在冒着一切风险去冒险，还是坚持现有的东西之间找到一个很好的平衡。我知道球队会一直努力到终场哨声响起，如果我们仍然在场，我们就会斗志昂扬，如果我们赢了，我们就会努力保持这种状态。艾琳·库斯伯特已经习惯了在切尔西赢得奖杯。她于 2016 年加入俱乐部，只错过了我们的前两座奖杯，此后她已经举起了 18 座奖杯。在去年曼城取得成功之前，这位苏格兰国脚是球队连续六次获得WSL冠军的关键成员，她决心在赛季结束时将冠军重新交到我们手中。 “在上个赛季之前，这是我们的奖杯六年了，所以当然感觉它已经被拿走了，”她解释道。 “但是曼城去年是合法的赢家，最终轻松击败了我们。 “人们在一定程度上想要夺回属于我们的东西，因为它已经属于我们太久了，但没有人拥有任何获得这个头衔的权利。它是通过整个赛季的努力工作和磨砺胜利而建立的，无论是好的、坏的还是丑陋的，我们都需要它。 “我们知道曼城现在已经做到了，所以我们必须做一切事情，甚至更多。我一直处于积分榜榜首的位置，而且我们赢得了联赛冠军，所以我知道当球队追赶你时是什么感觉。你感觉到他们在你脖子上呼吸。他们来找你了。你在每场比赛中都能感受到这一点。 “成为追赶者有点不同。我们现在是追逐者的一部分，所以这肯定是一种不同的心态，今年你会看到一些不同的东西：我们非常渴望它。周六观看比赛的观众将大饱眼福，大桥将展示 WSL 的最佳表现，两支前两名球队将争夺三分。如果曼城出击，他们可以打破客队深入低位的趋势，这将为我们的前锋提供展示能力的空间。尽管对库斯伯特来说这只是另一个获得三分的机会，但她的另一部分感觉赢得比赛将充分表明我们本赛季的意图。 “两支球队都知道对方在球场两端的实力，”队长继续说道。 “曼城有非常确定的比赛风格。他们不会袖手旁观，承受我们整场比赛的压力。他们会出来战斗，他们有非常好的技术球员，可以伤害我们，但同样我们也有这些球员。双方都会一拳接着一拳。 “他们的进攻意图可能会留下我们在联盟中并不总是有的空间，这为我们队中的一些球员提供了一种不同类型的比赛方式，让他们大放异彩。所以这无疑是一件令人兴奋的事情，但同时我们的防守可能会更加忙碌，我们对此也有预期。 “球队已经做好了准备，因为我认为本赛季我们在防守方面做得非常好，我认为后防线和其他所有人都功不可没，因为到目前为止，这项工作是具有里程碑意义的。”响应艾琳的行动号召，确保您在桥上的席位，为球队对阵曼城的比赛加油！门票可在此处购买。

news.title: Chelsea’s first-ever central London pop-up store opens for Christmas season

news.body_en: A new location in Covent Garden brings Chelsea merchandise and festive gifting to the heart of the capital. Chelsea Football Club today announces the opening of our first-ever retail pop-up store in central London, bringing a range of official merchandise, festive gifts and supporter favourites to the heart of the city's Christmas shopping district. Located at 6 Monmouth Street in Covent Garden, the pop-up store is open seven days a week from 12 November to 21 December. It is designed to make Chelsea gifting more accessible than ever for supporters and visitors looking for Christmas presents, while introducing the club's retail offering to a wider audience in central London. Among the many items in store are three designs of Christmas jumper, festive pyjamas and Proper Chels t-shirts and hoodies, plus smaller items including baubles, stockings, scarves and Santa’s hats, and even a festive jumper for dogs. That is in addition to all-year-round best-sellers like our home, away and third kits, and many ideas for stocking fillers. As part of the club’s continued commitment to supporting local communities, a percentage of sales from our festive range will contribute to our Christmas campaign - That's Proper Chels. The initiative supports people experiencing loneliness across London through the work of Chelsea Foundation and charities, including Age UK Kensington & Chelsea, Katherine Low Settlement and Fulham Good Neighbours. The Chelsea FC Christmas Pop-Up Store will be open: 6 Monmouth Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9HB Three- to five-minute walk from Covent Garden tube station on the Piccadilly Line If you cannot make it along to Covent Garden or the Megastore at Stamford Bridge, the Chelsea Christmas range is available from our online store.

news.body_en: Repeating the offer that was made for selected games last season and for this season's derby against Arsenal, Blues supporters are again invited to watch the young players developing in the Chelsea FC Women Academy in match action. The match takes place on Sunday 22 November at Kingsmeadow with kick-off at 1pm. Season ticket holders, Chelsea membership or any supporters under 20 years of age can claim one ticket free of charge for this fixture up until 12pm on Friday 20 November. Full ticket details are below. Chelsea Women’s young players compete as an under-18 squad in the Women’s Professional Game Academy U21 League. They made a strong start to the season, winning five games out of six in the southern section of the league and finishing top of that table. They play in a national Division One for the rest of the campaign. Current Chelsea Women first team squad members Aggie Beever-Jones, Lola Brown, Lexi Potter and Chloe Sarwie have all graduated from this development pathway. Now the next generation, who are coached by Leanne Champ, can be watched live. With the senior side now playing their games at Stamford Bridge and Plough Lane, this is also an opportunity for to see football at our historical home, Kingsmeadow in Kingston. Supporters who hold a season ticket, membership or any supporters who are a junior (under 20) can claim one ticket free of charge for this fixture up until 12pm on Friday 20 November 2026. You can do this by logging into your online account and selecting a ticket under the Chelsea Women Academy vs Birmingham Women's Academy event Tickets will be sold online only initially and will go off sale online on Sunday 22 November at 1pm. news.title: Once a Blue: Ron Harris
news.title_zh: 曾经的蓝色：罗恩·哈里斯
news.body_en: To mark the 82nd birthday of our record appearance maker Ron Harris, we revisit an interview he conducted reflecting on his illustrious Chelsea career. ‘Chopper’ Harris made his Blues debut in 1962 and his final appearance in 1980, 795 games and 14 goals later. He was the captain that lifted our first FA Cup trophy and first piece of European silverware, in the form of the Cup Winners’ Cup. Chopper’s Chelsea journey was quite a ride, so buckle up and enjoy this Q&A… Can you remember your first appearance way back in 1962? I captained the England youth side on the Wednesday and we won some little World Cup, and Tommy Docherty was there with my parents. He told me I'd be in the first team on the Saturday for the game against Sheffield Wednesday. We won 1-0 with Mickey Harrison getting the goal, and I marked a lad called Johnny Fantham. It was a real thrill for me as a 17-year-old lad. You had to bide your time before getting a proper run in the team, didn't you? I did stay in the team for a few games, but we went up to Everton and got hammered. That was it for me until the next year; we got relegated and in the Second Division I got a chance later in the season and we ended up getting promoted. The last game was against Portsmouth and we had to win to go up. I think the final score was 7-0! After that, I think I was a regular until my old team-mate Eddie McCreadie took over as manager. He was very superstitious and I was sub just about every week, occasionally coming on if someone was injured. I think I set a Chelsea record of playing in two games in one day. He thought I could do with a run-out with the reserves, so I went and played for them, and then they got a taxi to pick me up from Stamford Bridge to take me to Millwall. We were 3-0 down and at half-time Jock Finnieston had to come off so I played the second half. I can't imagine too many have done that – and I went to training the next day! Clear something up for us – were you a full-back or a centre-half? Because I wasn't gifted with pace, I enjoyed playing alongside the centre-half. I wasn't a big, dominant fella – I'm 5ft 8in – but you learned how to cope in other ways, using your body in the right way to compete against bigger players. I don't know the exact statistics but I think I played just as many games as a full-back as I did as a central defender. When I first came into the side I just man-marked people: Besty, Greavsie, Denis Law. Wherever they went, I used to follow. If I never touched the ball in a game and they didn't either, I knew I'd done a good job. I have to say, the hardest to man-mark was George Best – well, he was the hardest to try and kick! For a fella who was frail and skinny, he wasn't a coward. He could hold his own against anybody. Right foot, left foot; inside or out, he could take you wherever he wanted. I played against Pele a couple of times, too, but I think Best was the best I ever came across. I don't know, but we all got on very well. There was always a players' lounge and it was only for the players and their wives and girlfriends. There was no animosity if you'd given someone a hard time on the pitch – once the final whistle was blown, everything was forgotten. What I can say is that I'd love to have played with Besty, he gave me a few chasings. Having spent the best part of two decades in the first team, I imagine it must be pretty hard for you to highlight your favourite games for the club... Bearing in mind I didn't score too many during my career, we took on the Hammers just before the 1966 World Cup at Stamford Bridge and I scored two fantastic goals. I sliced one past Peter Bonetti for an own goal and then I went up the other end and hit a fantastic volley past Jim Standen! So that's one game. Then, in the 1971 Cup Winners' Cup run, me and Ossie didn't play in the first leg against Club Brugge when we lost 2-0, but we came back for the return and won 4-0. They were a useful side so that was a memorable game. Obviously the replay against Leeds United in the 1970 FA Cup final is another that stands out more than most, when we beat a tremendous side and became the first Chelsea team to lift the FA Cup. Then there's the European Cup Winners' Cup in Athens – another replay! We lost a goal in the last few seconds of the final, which was played on the Wednesday, and then on the Friday we had a replay and won 2-1. You've picked quite a few cup games there. I guess it sums up Chelsea during your time there, doesn't it? I've always said we were so inconsistent in the league – we could beat anybody on our day, but often when it came to taking on the lesser sides we'd go and get beaten. But with the cup games, the bigger the crowd, the better our star men responded. We had a great team. Peter Bonetti was fantastic in goal and the back four didn't take any prisoners; John Hollins did a great job in midfield while Charlie Cooke and Huddy pulled the strings, and Peter Houseman was a workaholic on the wing; and then you've got Hutch, who was a perfect foil for Ossie. I have to say, Os was the one of the best players I ever played alongside. He was tough as well as incredibly skilful. We had such a camaraderie. If one of the lads was getting a bit of a rough time on the pitch then there'd be one of their mates to help them out. I was privileged to captain a bunch of great lads and tremendous players. The closest you came to winning the league was in the 1964/65 season, when the Blues were top with three games left to play. Was that the year of the Blackpool incident? I've spoken to Tom [Docherty] on many occasions and I think he'll tell you that's the one thing he regretted. We had games against Burnley and Blackpool coming up so we went up there to stay for a few days. Tom said, “You've got to be in at a certain time” and everyone came back, but then some of them snuck out through the fire escape. He ended up sending them home, bringing in a load of youngsters, and we got beaten 6-2 against Burnley. I scored in that game, but I'd have preferred the win. Anyway, that put paid to our chances. The atmosphere between the lads and Tom was off – the whole situation got blown out of proportion and upset the apple cart. If he'd have just fined them a week's wages then I think we'd have probably gone on to win the league. Is that a regret from your time at Chelsea? Not a regret, but it would have been nice. It was the closest we ever came to the title. The balance of the side was the bigger the game, the better they performed. I'm not being disrespectful to some of the less fashionable sides in the First Division, but we just didn't perform against them on the smaller stage. You mention how long you spent at the club, but did you ever consider leaving before finally moving on for Brentford in 1980? I remember captaining England Under-23s when Bill Nicholson was manager and he asked me if I'd be interested in going to the Spurs because they'd love to have me there. But I had absolutely no intention of going there, and they ended up buying Dave Mackay – that was the end of it. Then, when Danny Blanchflower took over as manager we got beaten badly up at Middlesbrough in his first game and things hadn't been going great before that. Danny said to me, “Look, I'll put you in the picture: I'm going with the younger lads. Would you be interested in going to Luton?” David Pleat was the manager at the time and he was someone I'd played alongside at England youth level. Pleaty came round to my house in Epsom for a chat. He told me that I only had to come in to training on a Monday and a Friday – he just needed a bit of an old head for all the youngsters in his squad, someone to look after them. I had two young kids myself at that time and didn't really want to be travelling up there twice a week so I turned them down. Your older brother Allan also played for Chelsea. Does he ever get fed up with being known as Chopper's brother?! I don't think so. In fact, I reckon most people probably remember him for his managerial partnership with Terry Venables at Spurs and Barcelona. He played over 100 games for Chelsea and had the one thing I never did – pace. Was he one of the reasons you joined Chelsea? Yeah. In my day you'd go around all of the clubs so I tried out West Ham, Arsenal, Spurs and others. Then Allan decided on Chelsea and I followed him. When he went there I was a ballboy until I left school. Then I signed for the club. The rest is history – 795 games, 13 or 14 goals depending on you speak to. I'll take the 14, don't worry about that! You almost became a cricketer for Middlesex. What happened? Maybe I'd have done both if the seasons didn't overlap. Ron Tindall always used to miss the start of the football because of the cricket. So I went to see Ted Drake at Chelsea and he offered me £7 per week and a rail pass for the year. I went up to Lord's and was offered £4 per week to join the groundstaff but I had to pay my expenses. I was from a working-class family, so that swayed me. What does it mean to be our record appearance maker? I served under seven managers and what each of them got from me was 110 per cent effort in training and on the Saturday. I'm so proud of playing more games than any other player in the history of Chelsea Football Club and it's a record I don't think will ever be beaten. A version of this interview was first published in the official Chelsea matchday programme. You can buy past copies of the programme here.
news.body_zh: 为了纪念出场纪录创造者罗恩·哈里斯 (Ron Harris) 82 岁生日，我们回顾了他对切尔西辉煌职业生涯的采访。 “乔巴”哈里斯于 1962 年首次代表蓝军出场，并于 1980 年最后一次出场，随后出场 795 场比赛，攻入 14 个进球。他是我们的队长，举起了我们的第一座足总杯奖杯和第一座欧洲奖杯——优胜者杯。乔巴的切尔西之旅是一次相当愉快的旅程，所以系好安全带，享受这个问答吧……您还记得 1962 年您第一次亮相吗？周三我担任英格兰青年队队长，我们赢得了一些世界杯，汤米·多切蒂和我的父母一起在那里。他告诉我，我将在周六对阵谢菲尔德星期三的比赛中进入一线队。我们以 1-0 获胜，米基·哈里森 (Mickey Harrison) 进球，我盯防了一个名叫约翰尼·范瑟姆 (Johnny Fantham) 的小伙子。对于 17 岁的我来说，这真是一件令人兴奋的事。你必须等待时机才能在团队中得到适当的发挥，不是吗？我确实在球队呆了几场比赛，但我们去了埃弗顿并遭到了重击。这对我来说就是这样，直到明年。我们降级了，在赛季后期我在乙级联赛中获得了机会，最终我们升入了乙级联赛。上一场比赛是对阵朴茨茅斯，我们必须赢球才能晋级。我认为最终比分是7-0！在那之后，我认为我是一名常客，直到我的老队友埃迪·麦克雷迪接任主教练。他非常迷信，我几乎每周都会替补，偶尔在有人受伤时上场。我想我创造了切尔西一天踢两场比赛的纪录。他认为我可以和预备队一起出局，所以我去为他们效力，然后他们叫了一辆出租车从斯坦福桥接我到米尔沃尔。我们0-3落后，半场结束时乔克·芬尼斯顿不得不下场，所以我踢了下半场。我无法想象有太多人这样做了——第二天我就去参加了训练！为我们澄清一些事情——你是边后卫还是中后卫？因为我没有速度天赋，所以我喜欢和中卫一起踢球。我不是一个高大、有统治力的家伙——我身高 5 英尺 8 英寸——但你学会了如何以其他方式应对，以正确的方式利用你的身体与更大的球员竞争。我不知道确切的统计数据，但我认为我作为边后卫踢的比赛和作为中后卫踢的比赛一样多。当我第一次上场时，我只是盯防其他人：贝斯蒂、格里夫西、丹尼斯·劳。他们走到哪里，我就跟到哪里。如果我在一场比赛中从未触球而他们也没有触球，我就知道我做得很好。我不得不说，最难盯防的是乔治·贝斯特——好吧，他是最难尝试踢球的！对于一个又弱又瘦的小伙子来说，他并不是一个胆小鬼。他可以坚持自己的立场来对抗任何人。右脚，左脚；无论里面还是外面，他都可以带你去任何他想去的地方。我也和贝利交手过几次，但我认为贝斯特是我遇到过的最好的。我不知道，但我们相处得很好。总有一个球员休息室，仅供球员及其妻子和女朋友使用。如果你在球场上给某人制造了麻烦，那也不会产生敌意——一旦终场哨声吹响，一切都会被忘记。我能说的是，我很想和贝斯蒂一起打球，他给了我一些追逐。在一线队度过了二十年最美好的时光，我想你一定很难突出你最喜欢的俱乐部比赛……考虑到我在职业生涯中进球不多，1966年世界杯前夕我们在斯坦福桥迎战铁锤帮，我打进了两个精彩的进球。我切入彼得·博内蒂的乌龙球，然后我走到另一端，打出一记精彩的凌空抽射，越过吉姆·斯坦登！这就是一场比赛。然后，在1971年的优胜者杯比赛中，我和奥西在首回合对阵布鲁日的比赛中没有上场，当时我们0-2输球，但我们反击并以4-0获胜。他们是一支很有用的球队，所以这是一场令人难忘的比赛。显然，1970 年足总杯决赛对阵利兹联队的重赛是另一场比大多数比赛更引人注目的比赛，当时我们击败了一支强大的球队，成为第一支举起足总杯的切尔西队。然后是在雅典举行的欧洲优胜者杯赛——另一场重赛！周三的决赛我们在最后几秒丢了一球，周五我们重赛并以 2-1 获胜。你在那里挑选了很多杯赛。我想这就是你在切尔西期间的总结，不是吗？ 我总是说我们在联赛中的表现非常不稳定——我们可以击败任何人，但在对阵实力较弱的球队时，我们常常会被击败。但随着杯赛的进行，观众越多，我们的明星球员的反应就越好。我们有一支很棒的团队。彼得·博内蒂（Peter Bonetti）的进球非常出色，后防线上的四名球员没有俘获任何人。约翰·霍林斯（John Hollins）在中场表现出色，查理·库克（Charlie Cooke）和哈迪（Huddy）在幕后操纵，彼得·豪斯曼（Peter Houseman）在边路是个工作狂；然后还有哈奇，他是奥西的完美陪衬。我不得不说，奥斯是我搭档过的最好的球员之一。他很坚强，也非常有技巧。我们曾有过这样的友情。如果其中一个小伙子在球场上遇到了一些困难，那么他们的队友就会帮助他们摆脱困境。我很荣幸能带领一群伟大的小伙子和出色的球员。最接近赢得联赛冠军是在 1964/65 赛季，当时蓝军在还剩三场比赛时排名第一。那一年是布莱克浦事件发生的一年吗？我曾多次与汤姆[多赫蒂]交谈过，我想他会告诉你这是他后悔的一件事。我们即将对阵伯恩利和布莱克浦的比赛，所以我们去那里呆了几天。汤姆说：“你必须在某个时间进去”，然后每个人都回来了，但随后其中一些人从防火梯溜了出去。他最终把球队送回家，引进了很多年轻球员，我们以 6-2 击败了伯恩利。我在那场比赛中进球了，但我更希望获胜。无论如何，这让我们失去了机会。小伙子们和汤姆之间的气氛很不融洽——整个局势变得不成比例，搅乱了苹果车。如果他只罚他们一周的工资，那么我想我们可能会赢得联赛冠军。这是你在切尔西时期的遗憾吗？不是什么遗憾，但如果能这样就好了。这是我们距离标题最近的一次。双方的平衡是比赛规模越大，他们的表现就越好。我并不是对甲级联赛中一些不太时尚的球队不敬，但我们只是没有在较小的舞台上与他们对抗。你提到你在俱乐部呆了多久，但在 1980 年最终转会到布伦特福德之前，你有考虑过离开吗？我记得比尔·尼科尔森担任主教练时担任英格兰 23 岁以下国家队队长，他问我是否有兴趣去马刺队，因为他们很乐意让我在那里。但我完全无意去那里，他们最终买下了戴夫·麦凯——事情就这样结束了。然后，当丹尼·布兰奇弗劳尔（Danny Blanchflower）接任主教练时，我们在他的第一场比赛中在米德尔斯堡惨败，在那之前事情进展得并不顺利。丹尼对我说：“听着，我会把你放在照片里：我要和年轻的小伙子们一起去。你有兴趣去卢顿吗？”大卫·普利特（David Pleat）是当时的主教练，他是我在英格兰青年队并肩作战的人。普莱蒂来到我位于埃普瑟姆的家聊天。他告诉我，我只需要在周一和周五参加训练——他只需要为球队中的所有年轻人提供一个老头脑，有人来照顾他们。当时我自己有两个年幼的孩子，并不想每周去那里两次，所以我拒绝了他们。你的哥哥艾伦也曾为切尔西效力。他是否厌倦了被称为乔巴的兄弟？我不这么认为。事实上，我认为大多数人可能会因为他与热刺和巴塞罗那的特里·维纳布尔斯的管理伙伴关系而记住他。他为切尔西踢了 100 多场比赛，并且拥有我从未拥有过的一件事——速度。他是你加盟切尔西的原因之一吗？是的。在我那个时代，你会走遍所有的俱乐部，所以我尝试了西汉姆联、阿森纳、热刺等球队。然后艾伦决定选择切尔西，我也跟着他。当他去那里时，我是一名球童，直到我离开学校。然后我就和俱乐部签约了。剩下的就是历史了——795 场比赛，13 或 14 个进球，具体取决于你所说的。我会坐14号，不用担心！你差点成为米德尔塞克斯队的板球运动员。发生了什么？如果季节不重叠的话，也许我会两者都做。罗恩·廷德尔总是因为板球比赛而错过足球比赛的开始。所以我去切尔西见了特德·德雷克，他给了我每周 7 英镑和一年的铁路通票。我去了 Lord's，并获得每周 4 英镑的报酬来加入地勤人员，但我必须支付我的费用。 我来自一个工人阶级家庭，所以这影响了我。成为我们的出场记录创造者意味着什么？我在七位主教练手下工作过，他们每个人从我那里得到的都是在训练和周六的训练中付出了 110% 的努力。我为自己比切尔西足球俱乐部历史上任何其他球员出场次数都多而感到自豪，我认为这是一个永远不会被打破的记录。该采访的一个版本首先在切尔西官方比赛日节目中发布。您可以在此处购买该程序的过去版本。

news.title: Internationals: Rogers on target, Gusto features for France
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：罗杰斯进球，古斯托为法国队出场
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers maintained his impressive form by scoring in England's Nations League victory over Croatia this evening, while Malo Gusto started for France against Italy. Rogers has enjoyed an impressive start at Stamford Bridge since following his summer signing from Aston Villa. He has already contributed to ten goals in blue and earned a call-up from Thomas Tuchel for the latest round of England fixtures. The first came tonight at Wembley and Rogers, deployed on the right of the Three Lions' attack, broke the deadlock in the 24th minute. The goal was a poacher's effort, as the 24-year-old produced an intelligent close-range finish after a knock-down from Jude Bellingham. ICE COLD ❄️Morgan Rogers puts the Three Lions in front in the 24th minute 🙌#England #ThreeLions pic.twitter.com/lMCf51fP7F In the second half, Croatia equalised just before the hour-mark through Petar Sucic after the hosts failed to deal with a corner. However, England quickly restored their lead, with Harry Kane converting from the penalty spot on the night he became the Three Lions' most-capped player. Rogers went on to complete the full 90 minutes as England claimed a victory that leaves them second in Group C, three points behind Spain, who they take on this weekend at the Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. Meanwhile, in Group A, Malo Gusto started for France in their 3-1 defeat to Italy, for whom Marco Palestra was an unused substitute. Michael Olise opened the scoring for the visitors in the tenth minute, but that advantage was wiped out midway through the first half when Pio Esposito found the net. In the second period, Italy went ahead when Davide Frattesi struck, and Esposito extended an advantage the hosts did not relinquish. Gusto played 77 minutes of the game before being replaced by Sael Kumbedi. The other Group A fixture saw Belgium clinch a 2-1 away win over Turkiye. Blues midfielder Romeo Lavia missed the game due to suspension, while goalkeeper Mike Penders was an unused substitute. At youth level, Shim Mheuka scored twice as England Under-20s claimed a 6-1 win over their  Czech Republic counterparts. Mheuka, currently on loan at Celtic, started alongside fellow Blue Jesse Derry, who is spending the campaign at Sporting CP, and completed his brace before half-time as England established a commanding four-goal lead. The Young Lions added to the second period, during which Chelsea defender Tayo Subuloye was introduced from the substitutes' bench. England remain top of the UEFA Under-20 Elite League, having won their four matches. Portugal are fifth in the table after losing 1-0 to Italy. Blues winger Leo Cardoso was introduced as a late substitute, coming on in the 77th minute, but couldn't help his country rescue a point. And at Under-18 level, Isaac Badu featured in the closing stages as Portugal Under-18s clinched a 1-0 win over Norway Under-18s in friendly action.
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯在今晚英格兰战胜克罗地亚的国家联赛中进球，保持了令人印象深刻的状态，而马洛·古斯托则在法国对阵意大利的比赛中首发出场。 Rogers has enjoyed an impressive start at Stamford Bridge since following his summer signing from Aston Villa. He has already contributed to ten goals in blue and earned a call-up from Thomas Tuchel for the latest round of England fixtures.第一个进球发生在今晚的温布利，部署在三狮军团进攻右侧的罗杰斯在第 24 分钟打破了僵局。这个进球是偷猎者的进球，这位 24 岁的球员在击倒裘德·贝林厄姆后打出了一记聪明的近距离射门。 ICE COLD ❄️摩根·罗杰斯在第 24 分钟让三狮军团取得领先🙌#England #ThreeLions pic.twitter.com/lMCf51fP7F 下半场，克罗地亚队在主队未能处理角球后，在比赛结束前通过佩塔尔·苏西奇扳平比分。然而，英格兰队很快就恢复了领先优势，哈里·凯恩在成为三狮军团出场次数最多的球员的当晚主罚点球命中。罗杰斯打满了90分钟，英格兰队取得胜利，在C组排名第二，落后西班牙队三分，他们将于本周末在马德里大都会球场迎战西班牙队。 Meanwhile, in Group A, Malo Gusto started for France in their 3-1 defeat to Italy, for whom Marco Palestra was an unused substitute.迈克尔·奥利塞（Michael Olise）在第10分钟为客队首开纪录，但上半场中段，皮奥·埃斯波西托（Pio Esposito）破门，这一优势被抹去。第二节，意大利队凭借达维德·弗拉特西的进球取得领先，而埃斯波西托则扩大了东道主队的优势。古斯托在比赛中打满了 77 分钟，随后被萨尔·库姆贝迪 (Sael Kumbedi) 换下。 A组另一场比赛，比利时客场2-1战胜土耳其。蓝军中场罗密欧·拉维亚因停赛缺席了比赛，门将迈克·潘德斯则没有上场。在青年队，希姆·穆赫卡 (Shim Mheuka) 梅开二度，带领英格兰 20 岁以下青年队以 6-1 战胜捷克队。目前租借到凯尔特人队的姆赫卡与本赛季效力于里斯本竞技的蓝军队友杰西·德里一起首发，并在半场结束前梅开二度，帮助英格兰队建立了四球领先优势。 The Young Lions added to the second period, during which Chelsea defender Tayo Subuloye was introduced from the substitutes' bench.英格兰队在 UEFA 20 岁以下精英联赛中保持领先地位，赢得了四场比赛。葡萄牙0-1负于意大利，排名第五。蓝军边锋利奥·卡多佐在第77分钟替补上场，但没能帮助他的国家队挽回一分。在 U-18 级别比赛中，艾萨克·巴杜 (Isaac Badu) 在最后阶段发挥了重要作用，帮助葡萄牙 U-18 队在友谊赛中以 1-0 战胜了挪威 U-18 队。

news.title: PGA Cup report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 6-0 Ipswich Town
news.title_zh: PGA 杯赛报：切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 6-0 伊普斯维奇
news.body_en: Chelsea Women Under-18s progressed to the quarter-finals of the PGA Cup with a 6-0 victory over Ipswich Town Women Under-21s, with Stevie Sinclair scoring a hat-trick. Sinclair opened the scoring after eight minutes and Sadie Gregory doubled our advantage before the break. The Blues added two goals in as many minutes early in the second half through substitutes Aysia Matabaro and Tess Finn, before Sinclair struck twice more to complete her treble. Leanne Champ’s side controlled possession and combined well to create opportunities throughout Wednesday’s first-round tie. Disciplined work without the ball helped secure another clean sheet. Chelsea went ahead following a move started by Gregory, whose long diagonal pass found Zoe Ciccardini. Keira Johnson’s run beyond the Ipswich full-back created space for Ciccardini to play her into the box. Johnson delivered a first-time pass across goal and the unmarked Sinclair placed her finish into the bottom-left corner. The Blues doubled the lead on 33 minutes following a short free-kick involving Chloe Sarwie and Gabi Storey. Storey’s effort from the edge of the area was parried by the goalkeeper, and Gregory reacted to finish the loose ball. Champ made four changes at half-time, introducing Annie Boichat, Matabaro, Jahmya Putman and Finn for Sophie Leach, Rebekah Pierce, Chelsea N’Drin and Johnson. Matabaro added our third six minutes after the restart. Belle Sullivan and Ciccardini helped work the ball down the left to Putman, who beat her defender and drove inside before finding Matabaro across the edge of the box. She cut inside and finished across goal. The Blues scored again a minute later. Ciccardini intercepted a pass following the restart and found Putman, whose deflected cross reached Storey. Storey picked out Sinclair, who moved the ball wide to Matabaro. Her pass found Finn’s late run into the box, and the substitute finished first time. Sinclair scored her second on 62 minutes after Gregory collected a cleared corner and found Ciccardini on the right. Her deep cross reached Sinclair, who shifted the ball inside her defender and struck low into the bottom-right corner. Emelia Addison replaced Gregory on 70 minutes before Sinclair completed her hat-trick five minutes later. A short corner led to quick combinations between Sinclair, Storey and Sarwie. Receiving Sarwie’s pass, Sinclair drove across the pitch, skipped past two defenders and fired through the crowded penalty area from just outside the box. Chelsea advance to the quarter-finals of the PGA Cup following our first-round victory. The Blues return to PGA Division 1 action on Wednesday 18 November, travelling north to face Manchester United Women Under-21s. Kick-off is scheduled for 2pm. Chelsea: Bella Bartlett, Chloe Sarwie, Sadie Gregory (Emelia Addison 70), Sophie Leach (Annie Boichat h-t), Rebekah Pierce (Aysia Matabaro h-t), Belle Sullivan (c), Gabi Storey, Zoe Ciccardini, Stevie Sinclair, Chelsea N’Drin (Jahmya Putman h-t), Keira Johnson (Tess Finn h-t)Scorers: Sinclair 8, 62, 75, Gregory 33, Matabaro 51, Finn 52
news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下女子队以 6-0 战胜伊普斯威奇镇 21 岁以下女子队，晋级 PGA 杯四分之一决赛，史蒂夫·辛克莱 (Stevie Sinclair) 上演帽子戏法。辛克莱在八分钟后首开纪录，萨迪·格雷戈里在中场休息前将我们的优势扩大了一倍。蓝军在下半场刚开始的几分钟内就通过替补球员艾西亚·马塔巴罗和泰斯·芬恩攻入两球，随后辛克莱又梅开二度，完成了她的三冠王。 Leanne Champ 的球队控制了控球权，并在周三的首轮比赛中配合良好，创造了机会。纪律严明的无球训练帮助球队再次零失球。格雷戈里发起进攻后，切尔西取得领先，他的长对角传球找到了佐伊·西卡迪尼。凯拉·约翰逊（Keira Johnson）跑过伊普斯维奇后卫，为西卡迪尼（Ciccardini）将她带入禁区创造了空间。约翰逊第一次传球穿过球门，无人盯防的辛克莱将球射入左下角。第 33 分钟，克洛伊·萨尔维 (Chloe Sarwie) 和加比·斯托里 (Gabi Storey) 开出短距离任意球，蓝军将领先优势扩大一倍。斯托里在禁区边缘的射门被门将挡出，格雷戈里做出反应将球射出。钱普在半场进行了四次换人，用安妮·博伊查特、马塔巴罗、贾米亚·普特曼和芬恩换下索菲·利奇、丽贝卡·皮尔斯、切尔西·恩德林和约翰逊。比赛重新开始后六分钟，马塔巴罗打进了我们的第三个进球。贝尔·沙利文和西卡迪尼在左路将球传给了普特曼，普特曼突破了防守球员，带球内切，然后找到了禁区边缘的马塔巴罗。她切入内线并越过球门。一分钟后，蓝军再次进球。比赛重新开始后，西卡迪尼拦截了一次传球，找到普特曼，普特曼的传中偏转到达斯托里。斯托里挑选了辛克莱尔，后者将球传给了马塔巴罗。她的传球找到了芬恩后期冲入禁区的机会，替补球员首次完成射门。第 62 分钟，格雷戈里接到解围角球并找到右侧的奇卡迪尼，辛克莱尔攻入第二球。她的长传传到了辛克莱尔手中，辛克莱尔将球转移到防守球员的内侧，低射入球右下角。埃米莉亚·艾迪生 (Emelia Addison) 在第 70 分钟替换格雷戈里 (Gregory)，五分钟后辛克莱 (Sinclair) 完成帽子戏法。一个短角球导致辛克莱、斯托里和萨尔维快速组合。接到萨尔维的传球，辛克莱尔带球穿过球场，绕过两名防守球员，从禁区外射入拥挤的禁区。切尔西在首轮获胜后晋级 PGA 杯四分之一决赛。蓝军将于 11 月 18 日星期三重返 PGA Division 1 比赛，北上迎战曼联 21 岁以下女子队。开球时间定于下午2点。切尔西：贝拉·巴特利特、克洛伊·萨尔维、萨迪·格雷戈里（埃米莉亚·艾迪森 70）、苏菲·利奇（安妮·博伊查特）、丽贝卡·皮尔斯（艾西亚·马塔巴罗·h-t）、贝尔·沙利文（c）、加比·斯托里、佐伊·西卡迪尼、史蒂维·辛克莱、切尔西·恩德林（贾米亚·普特曼·h-t）、凯拉·约翰逊(Tess Finn h-t)得分手：辛克莱 8、62、75、格雷戈里 33、马塔巴罗 51、芬恩 52

news.title: Home Sweet Home: How the Chelsea Women players are settling in at Stamford Bridge
news.title_zh: 甜蜜之家：切尔西女足如何适应斯坦福桥
news.body_en: This weekend's clash with Manchester City will be our sixth Women's Super League game held at Stamford Bridge since we made it our new home. We sat down with four of our Blues to see how they are finding the move... Last season we played four league matches at the Bridge, against Arsenal, Manchester City, London City Lionesses and Manchester United. Now, having already turned out five times in SW6, it feels like an ideal time to check in with our players to see how their new home suits them. The opinions coming from inside the dressing room are unanimous: the move has been a resounding success. Whether it's a settled matchday routine, the atmosphere inside the stadium, or the feeling of butterflies when emerging from the tunnel, it's clear how our players are benefitting from their surroundings. We sat down with three players who remember what it was like to play at Kingsmeadow - Nathalie Bjorn, Kadeisha Buchanan and Erin Cuthbert - and one who has only known the Bridge, summer signing Melvine Malard. Here's what they had to say. 'The locker room is really nice. You're able to really activate and prepare for the game a lot better because there's more space. Obviously, the pitch is really nice and the atmosphere, too. 'The more fans we get, the merrier. A few times they really showed up for us. 'We want to keep that going because we definitely enjoy it when we walk out, and there are a lot of people there. It really boosts us up and gets that really good feeling going that today is going to be a really good game.' 'Stamford Bridge suits our style of play. It’s a bigger pitch, we love the locker room and it’s our home now – it’s our castle. We know it’s a transition process and will take time, but playing at a big stadium is what everyone wants to do. I think the fans really do enjoy it, the same as the players. 'The history of the stadium evokes a lot of feelings. Whether it’s against a top team or a lower team in the league, it still brings that extra fire in you. 'It’s just a feeling you have in your body. It’s a bit hard to explain, but like I said, with all the history and all the good games and the big games we played there before, being able to do that every weekend is a really nice feeling. 'You can hear our supporters throughout the game, which is really nice. They even celebrate if we do a great tackle, so having that support all the time, celebrating the small wins and getting that encouragement from the fans, is really amazing. And when we played Arsenal, for example, there were fireworks and the display in the stands – it was really cool. It creates a great atmosphere when they add those things. 'I would say: “Bring your friends, go to Bottomless at the Bridge, and then watch us play. Have a good time, and some drinks!”' 'It feels good to play at Stamford Bridge. I really love to enjoy playing in front of the fans. I'm a player who likes to celebrate a lot with the fans. In fact, I need to do it! When I score, I need to go over to the fans to make sure everyone has the same pleasure as we do when we play football. 'Everything's more familiar. Last season it maybe sometimes felt like we were playing an away game there, even though we weren't. 'When it’s your home, you've got your familiar settings, you know exactly where you're going, you know where you're eating pre-match, where you're getting treatment, where you're talking to the coaches, where you're doing the tactics. Everything is second nature. 'And on a matchday, the last thing you want as players is to think about anything other than your performance. So having taken all those variables out, I feel like everyone's settled and feels at home at the Bridge now. 'Hopefully the fans feel at home with our performances on the pitch, and their surroundings as well. We want to keep building our fanbase, keep growing, and give them the performances to match that.' Come and cheer on Chelsea Women in Saturday's huge game against Manchester City at the Bridge!
news.body_zh: 本周末与曼城的比赛将是我们自新主场以来在斯坦福桥举行的第六场女足超级联赛比赛。我们与我们的四名蓝军球员坐下来，看看他们如何找到转会的机会……上赛季我们在蓝桥踢了四场联赛，分别对阵阿森纳、曼城、伦敦城狮队和曼联。现在，我们已经在《SW6》中出场五次了，现在是时候与我们的玩家进行交流，看看他们的新家是否适合他们。更衣室内部的意见一致：此举取得了巨大成功。无论是固定的比赛日惯例、体育场内的气氛，还是从隧道中出现时的蝴蝶般的感觉，我们的球员都清楚地从他们的周围环境中受益。我们与三位记得在 Kingsmeadow 打球的感觉的球员坐下来——纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn)、卡德莎·布坎南 (Kadeisha Buchanan) 和艾琳·库斯伯特 (Erin Cuthbert)，以及一位只知道大桥的球员、夏季签约的梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard)。这是他们不得不说的。 “更衣室真的很棒。因为有更多的空间，您能够更好地真正激活并为游戏做好准备。显然，球场非常好，气氛也很好。 “我们的粉丝越多，我们就越开心。有几次他们真的出现在我们面前。 “我们希望继续下去，因为当我们走出去时，我们绝对很享受，而且那里有很多人。这确实让我们振奋起来，并让我们感觉非常好，因为今天将是一场非常精彩的比赛。” “斯坦福桥适合我们的比赛风格。这是一个更大的球场，我们喜欢更衣室，现在它是我们的家——这是我们的城堡。我们知道这是一个过渡过程，需要时间，但在大体育场比赛是每个人都想做的。我认为球迷真的很喜欢它，就像球员一样。 “这座体育场的历史唤起了很多感触。无论是对阵联盟中的顶级球队还是排名较低的球队，它仍然会给你带来额外的热情。 “这只是你身体里的一种感觉。这有点难以解释，但就像我说的，考虑到所有的历史、所有精彩的比赛以及我们之前在那里踢过的大型比赛，每个周末都能做到这一点真是一种很好的感觉。 “你可以在整个比赛中听到我们的支持者的声音，这真的很好。如果我们表现出色，他们甚至会庆祝，所以一直得到这种支持，庆祝小小的胜利并得到球迷的鼓励，真是太棒了。例如，当我们对阵阿森纳时，看台上有烟花和表演——这真的很酷。当他们添加这些东西时，它会营造出一种很棒的氛围。 “我会说：‘带上你的朋友，去桥上的 Bottomless，然后看我们比赛。祝你玩得开心，喝点饮料！’” “在斯坦福桥踢球感觉很好。”我真的很喜欢享受在球迷面前打球的感觉。我是一个喜欢和球迷一起庆祝的球员。事实上，我需要这样做！当我进球时，我需要走向球迷，以确保每个人都能像我们踢球时一样享受到乐趣。 '一切都更加熟悉了。上个赛季，有时我们可能会感觉我们是在客场比赛，尽管事实并非如此。 “当这是你的家时，你有熟悉的环境，你确切地知道你要去哪里，你知道你赛前在哪里吃饭，你在哪里接受治疗，你在哪里与教练交谈，你在哪里执行战术。一切都是第二天性。 “在比赛日，作为球员，你最不想做的事情就是考虑自己表现以外的任何事情。因此，在排除所有这些变量之后，我觉得每个人都已经安顿下来，现在在桥上感觉宾至如归。 “希望球迷们对我们在球场上的表现以及他们的周围环境感到宾至如归。我们希望继续建立我们的粉丝群，不断成长，并为他们提供与之相匹配的表演。”快来为切尔西女足周六在蓝桥对阵曼城的大型比赛中加油吧！

news.title: Malo Gusto joins the ranks of Chelsea’s French centurions
news.title_zh: 马洛·古斯托加入切尔西法国百夫长行列
news.body_en: Shortly before heading off to represent his country this week, Malo Gusto made his 100th Premier League appearance for Chelsea, becoming the eighth French international to hit a century for the Blues in that competition. Gusto is currently away as part of Zinedine Zidane’s France squad. They are attempting to hold on to top spot in their UEFA Nations League group and seal qualification for the quarter-finals in their final two games, against Marco Palestra’s Italy tonight and Turkiye on Sunday. In his last game before meeting up with Les Bleus, Gusto came off the bench for Chelsea in our Premier League away fixture at Sunderland, making his 100th appearance for the club in that competition, and 144th in total since arriving from Lyon three years ago. The 23-year-old joins an illustrious list of Frenchmen to have reached a century of games for the club in the Premier League, but who are the other seven Blues to have hit that landmark? Anelka was slow out the blocks for Chelsea, but he more than made up for it in his first full season, in 2008/09. A tally of 19 goals earned him the Premier League Golden Boot award – just the second Frenchman to win it, after Thierry Henry. He netted exactly half of his Premier League goals for the Blues that season, although his intelligent link play was an understated factor during a successful era for the club. The cultured defender was one half of an all-French centre-back pairing with Marcel Desailly that enjoyed plenty of success for club and country. In addition to his defensive strength and quality on the ball, particularly when spraying passes out from the back, Leboeuf also got his share of goals from penalties and some spectacular long-rangers. Famously the holding midfield player who was so good they named his position after him. ‘The Makelele role’ became a common term for a defensive-midfielder in the Premier League, but no one seemed to do it quite as well as him. He was a vital cog in the make-up of two title-winning sides, someone who made the game that much easier for his team-mates. Just like Gusto, the left-winger joined us from Lyon, and did so as the reigning Ligue 1 Player of the Year. Malouda hit top form during our 2009/10 Double-winning season as a key source of both goals and assists. Better was to follow in front of goal the following campaign, as he netted 13 times in the Premier League to finish as our leading scorer. Two-time Champions League winner Desailly joined the Blues shortly before going on to lift the 1998 World Cup with France – alongside Leboeuf – on home soil, and it was not long before Chelsea fans found out just why he was known as The Rock. The defender was at his imposing best in our 2000 FA Cup triumph and during our maiden voyage in the Champions League. He was also the natural successor to Dennis Wise as skipper. Some Chelsea fans have not forgiven Gallas for departing the club for Arsenal as part of the deal which brought Ashley Cole to Stamford Bridge in the summer of 2006, but there is no doubting the key role he played in two title-winning sides. His stunning late winner against Tottenham Hotspur lives long in the memory and he was also part of the defence which set a Premier League low of only 15 goals conceded in 2004/05. Although a quiet character, there was nothing understated about Kante’s performances as we reclaimed our top-flight crown from his former club Leicester City in 2016/17. He was the dominant midfield player in the country and an obvious choice for numerous individual prizes that term. There was also arguably no-one as important as NG in our run to Champions League glory in Porto in 2021, as he was named Man of the Match in virtually every knockout game that season,
news.body_zh: 就在本周代表国家队出战前不久，马洛·古斯托代表切尔西完成了他在英超联赛中的第 100 场比赛，成为第八位在该赛事中为蓝军打进百分的法国国脚。古斯托目前作为齐达内法国队的一员离开。他们正试图保住欧洲国家联赛小组头名的位置，并在最后两场比赛中锁定四分之一决赛的资格，今晚对阵马尔科·帕莱斯特拉的意大利队，周日对阵土耳其队。在与高卢军团会面之前的最后一场比赛中，古斯托在英超客场对阵桑德兰的比赛中为切尔西替补出场，这是他在这场比赛中第 100 次代表俱乐部出场，也是自三年前从里昂加盟以来总共第 144 次出场。这位 23 岁的球员加入了为俱乐部效力英超百年的杰出法国人名单，但其他七名实现这一里程碑的蓝军球员是谁呢？阿内尔卡在切尔西的表现很慢，但他在2008/09赛季的第一个完整赛季中弥补了这一点。 19 粒进球为他赢得了英超金靴奖，这是继蒂埃里·亨利之后第二位获此殊荣的法国人。那个赛季他为蓝军攻入的英超进球正好有一半，尽管在俱乐部的成功时代，他的聪明才智的表现是一个被低估的因素。这位训练有素的后卫是与马塞尔·德塞利搭档的全法国中后卫之一，他们为俱乐部和国家队取得了巨大的成功。除了他的防守强度和控球质量，特别是从后场传球时，勒伯夫还通过点球和一些精彩的远射获得了进球。这位著名的控卫中场球员非常出色，他们以他的名字命名了他的位置。 “马克莱莱角色”成为英超联赛中防守型中场球员的常用术语，但似乎没有人做得比他更好。他是两支夺冠球队中至关重要的一环，他让队友们的比赛变得更加轻松。就像古斯托一样，这位左翼球员从里昂加盟我们，并成为卫冕法甲年度最佳球员。马卢达在我们的 2009/10 双冠赛季中达到了最佳状态，成为进球和助攻的关键来源。更好的是在接下来的赛季中追随球门，他在英超联赛中攻入 13 球，成为我们的头号射手。两届欧冠冠军得主德塞利加盟蓝军不久，随后与勒伯夫一起在本土随法国队捧起 1998 年世界杯冠军，不久之后，切尔西球迷就发现了他被称为“巨石”的原因。这位后卫在我们2000年足总杯的胜利以及我们在冠军联赛的处女航中都展现出了他的最佳状态。他也是丹尼斯·怀斯船长的自然继任者。一些切尔西球迷并没有原谅加拉斯离开俱乐部加盟阿森纳，这是2006年夏天将阿什利·科尔带到斯坦福桥的交易的一部分，但毫无疑问他在两支夺冠球队中发挥了关键作用。他在对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中最后时刻令人惊叹的制胜球永远留在人们的记忆中，他也是防守组的一员，创下了2004/05赛季英超联赛失球数最低的15个。虽然坎特性格安静，但他的表现丝毫不被低估，我们在 2016/17 赛季从他的前东家莱斯特城手中夺回了顶级联赛的桂冠。他是该国最具统治力的中场球员，也是该赛季获得众多个人奖项的明显人选。在 2021 年波尔图夺得欧冠冠军的过程中，可以说没有人比 NG 更重要，因为他几乎在该赛季的每场淘汰赛中都被评为全场最佳球员，

news.title: Meet the Constant Contact small businesses activating at CFCW matchday
news.title_zh: 认识在 CFCW 比赛日活跃的持续接触小型企业
news.body_en:
Chelsea FC Women and our principal partner, Constant Contact, are making the most of one of the biggest occasions of the WSL season to give small businesses the opportunity to be part of a matchday at Stamford Bridge. On Saturday, the top two in the league table go head to head when the Blues host Manchester City and three companies, Leo's Circus, Cheer London Allstarz and Popchoir, will be showcasing their work to supporters there for the game. All three female-founded businesses are Constant Contact customers. Constant Contact, CFCW’s training kit partner, is the AI-powered marketing partner for small businesses, nonprofits, franchises, multi-location brands and estate agents. In the lead-up to their matchday at the Bridge, the founders of the businesses visited Cobham to meet CFCW stars Erin Cuthbert, Aggie Beever-Jones and Melvine Malard. They were keen to help with the project, sharing in the ideas generated for how the business could be seen by more people this weekend. Fans at the game will now see those ideas come to life on Saturday. The three businesses involved this matchday all focus on driving participation among local London communities. Leo's Circus is a circus and aerial school, running camps for children. They will be located nearby Britannia Gate from 11am to 1pm, performing circus skills. Children will have the chance to win a golden ticket, and a place at one of their circus camps, by completing the plate-spinning challenge. View this post on Instagram            
Cheer London Allstarz is a grassroots cheer and tumbling club. Their young squad will have a routine incorporating the players' celebration poses. Look out for that by the East Stand entrance at 11am. Popchoir is an adult community choir which will be performing by Britannia Gate from 12.15pm to 1.15pm, with songs that inspire excitement for gameday including their version of Blue Is The Colour. news.title: Isaac Collinson signs professional contract
news.title_zh: 艾萨克·科林森签署职业合同
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Academy goalkeeper Isaac Collinson has signed his first professional contract with the Blues. Collinson joined Chelsea during his Under-15 season and has developed into a confident and commanding goalkeeper. Last season, Collinson made his Under-18 debut in the Premier League Cup during a 3-3 draw at Cobham. On the international stage, he has previously represented England’s Young Lions at Under-15 and Under-16 level. He has signed the professional deal following his 17th birthday, having signed a scholarship contract back in July 2026.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布青训门将艾萨克·科林森与蓝军签订了他的第一份职业合同。科林森在U-15赛季加盟切尔西，并已发展成为一名自信且具有指挥能力的门将。上赛季，科林森在英超杯3-3战平科巴姆的比赛中首次亮相18岁以下青年队。在国际舞台上，他曾代表英格兰幼狮队参加过 15 岁以下和 16 岁以下级别的比赛。他在 17 岁生日后签署了这份职业合同，并于 2026 年 7 月签署了一份奖学金合同。

news.title: Chelsea Women vs Man City: How to watch, kick-off time, live stream info
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足对阵曼城：如何观看、开球时间、直播信息
news.body_en: We are back at Stamford Bridge on Saturday afternoon for a huge fixture against Manchester City in the Women's Super League. This weekend’s match in SW6 is a contest between the top two sides in this season’s Women’s Super League. Chelsea trail Man City by two points with nine games played. London City Lionesses are a further four points behind the Blues. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Man City, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Manchester City takes place on Saturday 14 November 2026 at Stamford Bridge, with kick-off scheduled for 1.30pm UK time. The best way to see the game is to join us at the Bridge! Tickets are still available to purchase here. If you can't make the game in person,  then you can watch the action live on BBC One. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. The Blues have won seven and drawn two of our nine WSL fixtures so far, with last weekend's 1-1 against Everton ending a seven-game winning streak in the league. We have not failed to win back-to-back top-flight home matches since February/March 2018, when we drew with Manchester City and Reading. Chelsea have had 215 shots in the WSL this season – our average of 24 shots per game is the most by a team in a season in WSL history. Manchester City have won 25 points in their first nine WSL matches this season (W8 D1), their most at this stage of a season since 2017/18 (also 25). As well as the two league meetings last season - one won, one lost - we also played Manchester City in both domestic cup competitions, winning one tie and losing the other. In a League Cup semi-final, a Wieke Kaptein goal secured a 1-0 win away from home. In an FA Cup semi-final at Stamford Bridge, goals from Erin Cuthbert and Sam Kerr were not sufficient to prevent a 3-2 defeat. Manchester City have won just one of their last nine WSL away games against Chelsea (D2 L6), a 1-0 success at Kingsmeadow in February 2024. Chelsea have not lost back-to-back league games against City since a run of four between 2015 and 2017. We suffered our joint-second biggest WSL defeat in our last meeting with Manchester City in February (1-5).

news.title: Chelsea Football Club marks 10 years since historic sexual abuse disclosures in football
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部纪念足球界历史性性虐待事件披露十周年
news.body_en: November 2026 marks ten years since survivors of childhood sexual abuse began speaking publicly about their experiences in football. Their courage brought to light serious failures in the protection of children and young people and prompted significant change across the game. Chelsea Football Club recognises its own place in this history and acknowledges the harm experienced by those who were failed. We recognise that the impact of abuse can be lifelong and that the experiences of survivors must remain at the centre of how this anniversary is acknowledged. As we mark ten years since these disclosures, we recognise everyone affected by abuse, including those who have not felt able to speak about their experiences. We support the FA's survivor-led Voices of Truth initiative and remain committed to listening to those affected, learning from the past and ensuring that safeguarding remains a priority across the Club. We recognise that this anniversary may be difficult for some people. Anyone affected by abuse who wishes to seek advice, share information or access support can contact the following organisations. If you have experienced or been affected by abuse connected to Chelsea Football Club, whether historic or current, you can contact the Club's Safeguarding Team to discuss your concerns and the support available. Email: safeguarding@chelseafc.com The FA's Voices of Truth platform provides information about the anniversary, relevant independent reviews and support available to those affected by abuse in football. Telephone: 0800 169 1863 (leave a message) NAPAC provides confidential support and information for adults who experienced abuse in childhood. The NSPCC provides advice and support for anyone concerned about the safety or wellbeing of a child. For adults affected by childhood sexual abuse in football, the NSPCC also has a dedicated helpline:

news.title: Late Stamford Bridge winners: vote for your favourite on the Chelsea Official App!
news.title_zh: 斯坦福桥已故获奖者：在切尔西官方应用程序上为您最喜欢的球员投票！
news.body_en: Nothing beats a late winner at Stamford Bridge. The limbs behind the goal. The players racing to one of the corners to celebrate. The banging of the Matthew Harding Stand billboards. There have plenty to enjoy over the years, and now we are asking you to pick your favourite. To help shorten our very lengthy longlist, we have limited our selections to Premier League winners. And they must have been scored in the 85th minute or later. It was incredibly tough for whittle them down to just eight, so we apologise if your favourite didn’t make the final selection! From Lampard to Leboeuf, Estevao to Willian, there are recent and past classics on momentous days in SW6 that will live long in the memory. We start with the quarter-finals today, with the eight goals split into four ties. Watch them back and then vote for your favourite on the Chelsea Official App, with the winners progressing to Saturday’s semis. The grand final will be on Monday! We’ve also added a few lines on each goal for added context if you need help making your mind up! Frank Leboeuf vs Leicester - 1997 Ruud Gullit's Blues had huffed and puffed all game without reward. That was until the ball rolled invitingly into Frank Leboeuf's path, with the centre-back stepping on to it and larruping a spectacular drive into the top corner. William Gallas vs Tottenham - 2006 On the day the King of Stamford Bridge Peter Osgood died, William Gallas conjured up a dramatic late winner from distance at Ossie's beloved Shed End. Claude Makelele vs Charlton - 2005 Claude Makelele chose a memorable moment to score his first Chelsea goal, getting the party started on the day we lifted the Premier League title for the first time with a rebound from his own spot-kick. Estevao Willian vs Liverpool - 2025 We don't think we need to remind you about Estevao's sliding stoppage-time winner against the reigning champions Liverpool last year! Frank Lampard vs Stoke City - 2009 Trailing 1-0, Juliano Belletti drew us level with two minutes to go before Lampard won it in stoppage time with a rising left-footed drive that had the foundations of the Bridge shaking. The Blues were scrapping hard at the top of the table in 2014/15, so it was looking like two points dropped with a goalless draw against Everton. Step forward Willian, whose low striker from a cleared corner find its way into the bottom corner. Fernando Torres vs Man City - 2013 A top-of-the-table clash was settled by Fernando Torres right at the end after a mistake in the Man City backline gave the striker a free run at goal and a tap-in. Cole Palmer vs Man United - 2024 The second-latest winner in Premier League history - after 100 minutes and 41 seconds - was scored by Cole Palmer at the conclusion of a topsy-turvy epic in which our attacker had already equalised deep into stoppage time.
news.body_zh: 没有什么比斯坦福桥的最后时刻的胜利更胜一筹了。球门后面的四肢。球员们争先恐后地跑到一个角落庆祝。马修·哈丁看台广告牌的撞击声。这些年来有很多东西可以享受，现在我们请您选择您最喜欢的。为了帮助缩短我们冗长的名单，我们将选择范围限制为英超冠军。而且他们一定是在第85分钟或更晚的时候进球的。将它们减少到只有八个是非常困难的，所以如果您最喜欢的没有进入最终选择，我们深表歉意！从兰帕德到勒博夫，从埃斯特沃到威廉，SW6 重要日子里近期和过去的经典将永远留在人们的记忆中。今天我们从四分之一决赛开始，八个进球分成四场平局。观看他们的比赛，然后在切尔西官方应用程序上投票选出您最喜欢的球队，获胜者将晋级周六的半决赛。总决赛将于周一举行！如果您需要帮助做出决定，我们还在每个目标上添加了几行内容以添加背景信息！弗兰克·勒博夫 vs 莱斯特城 - 1997 年，路德·古力特的蓝军在整场比赛中都气喘吁吁，没有得到任何回报。直到球诱人地滚入弗兰克·勒伯夫的路径，中后卫踩到球并以惊人的射门进入上角。威廉·加拉斯 vs 托特纳姆热刺 - 2006 在斯坦福桥之王彼得·奥斯古德去世的那天，威廉·加拉斯在奥西心爱的谢德恩德球场从远处召唤出戏剧性的最后胜利者。克劳德·马克莱莱 vs 查尔顿 - 2005 年 克劳德·马克莱莱选择了一个值得纪念的时刻，打进了他在切尔西的第一个进球，他凭借自己的点球反弹，为我们首次捧起英超冠军的那天拉开了序幕。埃斯特沃·威廉 vs 利物浦 - 2025 我们认为我们不需要提醒您去年埃斯特沃在对阵卫冕冠军利物浦的补时阶段的绝杀！弗兰克·兰帕德 vs 斯托克城 - 2009 年 0-1 落后的情况下，朱利亚诺·贝莱蒂在比赛还剩两分钟时将我们扳平，但兰帕德在伤停补时阶段的左脚射门让大桥的地基都摇晃起来，赢得了比赛。 2014/15赛季，蓝军在积分榜榜首的位置上拼尽全力，所以在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中，蓝军0-0战平，看起来像是丢了两分。威廉向前推进，他的低射门从空缺角球射入底角。费尔南多·托雷斯 vs 曼城 - 2013 一场积分榜榜首的比赛在最后时刻由费尔南多·托雷斯解决，曼城后防线的失误让前锋获得了一次射门机会并射门得分。科尔·帕尔默 vs 曼联 - 2024 英超历史上第二晚的制胜球——在 100 分 41 秒后——由科尔·帕尔默打进，结束了一场混乱的史诗般的比赛，我们的攻击手在伤停补时阶段已经扳平比分。

news.title: UEFA Nations League: What the Chelsea players need
news.title_zh: 欧洲国家联赛：切尔西球员需要什么
news.body_en: The group stage of the UEFA Nations League concludes over the next week, when seven Chelsea players could be in action for their countries with a chance of featuring in the quarter-finals. Spain and defending champions Portugal became the first teams to book their place in the last eight, during the September and October international break. By the end of this window, the rest of the line-up for March's quarter-finals will be completed, ahead of next summer's final tournament. All seven Blues called up by European teams this week have the chance to be there, going into the final two fixtures of the group stage. Here is what they all need to ensure they have a chance to lift the trophy in June. The first group is packed full of Chelsea interest with Malo Gusto, Marco Palestra, Mike Penders and Romeo Lavia all in contention to feature for their countries, representing more than half of the Blues’ seven players called up for Nations League duty in October. Lavia will be suspended when Belgium attempt to repeat last month’s 3-0 win over pointless Turkiye, but will be available to rejoin Penders and Co for what could be a crucial final fixture at home against Italy. Palestra’s Italy sit second, three points behind leaders France and Gusto, one ahead of Belgium. The French's advantage means that even if they lose that first game – and Italy are the only side to deny Les Bleus victory so far – a point against bottom-placed Turkiye would still guarantee them a quarter-final spot, leaving Belgium and Italy to fight it out for the second qualification place. Turkiye vs Belgium, Thursday 12 November, 5pmItaly vs France, Thursday 12 November, 7.45pmFrance vs Turkiye, Sunday 15 November, 7.45pmBelgium vs Italy, Sunday 15 November, 7.45pm Jorrel Hato is not joining the Netherlands squad this month after missing Chelsea’s last three games, although Xabi Alonso is hopeful he will be back at the end of this international break. By then, Hato's international team-mates could have booked their place in the Nations League quarter-finals, going into these games sat at the top of a very tight group. Netherlands vs Greece, Friday 13 November, 7.45pmSerbia vs Germany, Friday 13 November, 7.45pmGermany vs Netherlands, Tuesday 17 November, 7.45pmGreece vs Serbia, Tuesday 17 November, 7.45pm All English eyes will be on veteran captain and this year’s Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane, who is the current Nations League top scorer and will become his country’s all-time appearance maker in his next game. For Chelsea, though, the focus is on fellow attacker Morgan Rogers, Kane’s younger by almost exactly nine years. Spain are already into the quarter-finals and England are on the verge of joining them in second. A point in the Three Lions’ first game against Croatia would seal the deal, avoiding the need to become the first side to take a point off the Spanish. However, with an advantage over third-placed Croatia of six points and a goal difference 21 better, it would take something incredible to deny England a spot in the last eight, regardless. England vs Croatia, Thursday 12 November, 7.45pmCzechia vs Spain, Thursday 12 November, 7.45pmCroatia vs Czechia, Sunday 15 November, 7.45pmSpain vs England, Sunday 15 November, 7.45pm Portugal have already booked their place in the quarter-finals with four wins from as many games so far, and need just a point to guarantee they finish top of their group. That leaves them with little to play for in their games against Denmark and Wales, although they start a new era under coach Jorge Jesus after long-time captain and national hero Cristiano Ronaldo announced his retirement from international football. Chelsea duo Pedro Neto and Geovany Quenda will both be looking to stake their claim for a place in that new-look attack after being called up for these concluding fixtures to the Nations League group. Norway vs Wales, Saturday 14 November, 5pmPortugal vs Denmark, Saturday 14 November, 7.45pmDenmark vs Norway, Tuesday 17 November, 7.45pmWales vs Portugal, Tuesday 17 November, 7.45pm

news.title: Chelsea FC Soccer Schools launches in Australia, bringing our coaching philosophy to thousands of young players
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校在澳大利亚成立，将我们的教练理念带给数千名年轻球员
news.body_en: Chelsea FC Soccer Schools is expanding our international programme with the launch of new Soccer Camps in Australia, bringing the club’s renowned coaching methodology and player development approach to young footballers across Melbourne, Sydney and Canberra in January 2027. The camps are a new addition to the growing Chelsea FC Soccer Schools programme, which since 2010 has provided accessible football opportunities for thousands of young people across schools and communities. Designed to inspire a lifelong love of the game, the programmes use the power of football to encourage children and young people to stay active, develop new skills, build confidence and create lasting friendships. At the heart of Chelsea FC Soccer Schools is a commitment to inspiring, educating and engaging the next generation through football. While developing technical ability on the pitch remains a key focus, the programmes are equally dedicated to promoting teamwork, resilience, wellbeing and healthy lifestyles, creating positive experiences that extend far beyond the game itself. Toni Claveria, Director of Football Schools for Chelsea Football Club, said: ‘We are delighted to bring Chelsea FC Soccer Schools to Australia, giving young players the opportunity to experience the club's coaching philosophy while using the power of football to build confidence, create friendships and inspire healthy, active lifestyles. ‘Australia is home to a passionate Chelsea community and, following the visits of both our men's and women's teams during this summer's pre-season tours, we're excited to return so soon. These camps provide a fantastic opportunity to connect with our fans in-country, strengthen our relationship with local communities and inspire the next generation through the game we all love.’ The Australian Soccer Camps will take place over three consecutive weeks in January 2027, giving young players the opportunity to learn directly from official Chelsea FC coaches and experience the club’s coaching philosophy firsthand. Melbourne: 11-15 January at Darebin International Sports Centre Sydney: 18-22 January at North Turramurra Recreation Area Canberra: 25-29 January at David Madew Oval Two programmes will be available at each location. Click to register for the camps. The Development Camp, for boys and girls aged 6-14, will run daily from 8am to 1pm, providing a fun, inclusive and professional environment where players can improve their technical skills, game understanding and confidence. The Performance Camp, for boys and girls aged 15-17, will run from 2.30pm to 5pm and is designed for committed players seeking to further develop their game. Delivered to a smaller, more exclusive group, the programme offers a higher level of individual attention and coaching, supporting talented young players on their football development journey. All camps will be delivered by official Chelsea FC coaches travelling from the UK, ensuring participants experience the same coaching principles and player-centred approach that underpin Chelsea FC Soccer Schools around the world. Five days of coaching delivered by official Chelsea FC coaches An official Chelsea FC Soccer Camps training kit, including t-shirt, shorts and socks Water and fruit throughout the day to support hydration and healthy habits An official Chelsea FC Soccer Camps certificate upon completion The launch forms part of Chelsea FC Soccer Schools' wider ambition to make football accessible to more young people globally, using the game's unique ability to bring communities together, inspire positive change and strengthen connections between the club and its supporters around the world. By expanding into Australia, Chelsea FC Soccer Schools will give young players and families the opportunity to engage directly with the club, while experiencing a programme designed not only to develop footballers but also to encourage confidence, friendship, healthy lifestyles and a lifelong passion for sport. news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校正在扩大我们的国际计划，在澳大利亚推出新的足球训练营，将于 2027 年 1 月为墨尔本、悉尼和堪培拉的年轻足球运动员带来俱乐部著名的教练方法和球员发展方法。这些训练营是不断发展的切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校计划的新增内容，自 2010 年以来，该计划已为学校和社区的数千名年轻人提供了足球机会。这些计划旨在激发对足球运动的终生热爱，利用足球的力量鼓励儿童和青少年保持活跃、发展新技能、建立信心并建立持久的友谊。切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校的核心是致力于通过足球激励、教育和吸引下一代。虽然发展球场上的技术能力仍然是一个重点，但这些项目同样致力于促进团队合作、韧性、福祉和健康的生活方式，创造远远超出比赛本身的积极体验。切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校总监托尼·克拉维拉表示：“我们很高兴将切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校引入澳大利亚，让年轻球员有机会体验俱乐部的教练理念，同时利用足球的力量建立信心、建立友谊并激发健康、积极的生活方式。 “澳大利亚是充满激情的切尔西社区的故乡，继我们的男队和女队在今年夏天的季前巡回赛期间访问之后，我们很高兴能这么快回来。这些训练营提供了一个绝佳的机会，让我们能够与国内球迷建立联系，加强我们与当地社区的关系，并通过我们都喜爱的比赛激励下一代。”澳大利亚足球训练营将于 2027 年 1 月连续举办三周，让年轻球员有机会直接向切尔西足球俱乐部官方教练学习，并亲身体验俱乐部的教练理念。墨尔本：1 月 11 日至 15 日在戴宾国际体育中心 悉尼：1 月 18 日至 22 日在 North Turramurra 休闲区 堪培拉：1 月 25 日至 29 日在 David Madew Oval 每个地点将提供两个项目。点击报名参加夏令营。面向 6 至 14 岁男孩和女孩的发展营将于每天上午 8 点至下午 1 点进行，提供一个有趣、包容和专业的环境，让玩家可以提高他们的技术技能、游戏理解和信心。表演营面向 15 至 17 岁的男孩和女孩，活动时间为下午 2.30 至下午 5 点，专为寻求进一步发展游戏水平的忠实玩家而设计。该计划面向规模更小、更独特的群体，提供更高水平的个人关注和指导，支持有才华的年轻球员的足球发展之旅。所有训练营都将由来自英国的切尔西足球俱乐部官方教练授课，确保参与者体验与世界各地切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校相同的教练原则和以球员为中心的方法。由切尔西足球俱乐部官方教练提供的为期五天的指导 切尔西足球俱乐部官方足球训练营训练套件，包括 T 恤、短裤和袜子 全天提供水和水果，以支持水分和健康习惯 完成后获得官方切尔西足球俱乐部足球训练营证书 此次推出是切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校更广泛目标的一部分，即让全球更多的年轻人接触到足球，利用这项运动的独特能力将社区团结在一起，激发积极的变革并加强俱乐部与世界​​各地支持者之间的联系。通过扩展到澳大利亚，切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校将为年轻球员和家庭提供直接与俱乐部互动的机会，同时体验不仅旨在培养足球运动员的计划，还旨在鼓励自信、友谊、健康的生活方式和对运动的终生热情。点击注册澳大利亚切尔西足球俱乐部足球学校

news.title: Vote for your CFCW October Player of the Month on the Chelsea Official App
news.title_zh: 在切尔西官方应用程序上投票选出 CFCW 十月月度最佳球员
news.body_en: Chelsea enjoyed a perfect month in October, winning Women's Super League matches against West Ham United, Crystal Palace and Tottenham Hotspur, while also recording a victory over Roma in the UEFA Women's Champions League. We began with a 3-0 away win against West Ham United before the players departed for international duty. They returned to face Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on 18 October and romped to a 6-2 triumph in front of our supporters. Click here to cast your vote for October Player of the Month on the Chelsea Official App Next came a tricky test away at Crystal Palace, when the Eagles took a first-half lead, yet the Blues managed a complete turnaround after the break to complete a 3-1 win. Rounding off a successful month was a 2-0 victory over Roma at Plough Lane in the Champions League. With October now over, it is time to have your say on who receives the latest Chelsea Women Player of the Month award, by joining the vote on the Chelsea Official App. Our Star of the Match winners from October Ellie Carpenter, Lauren James and Keira Walsh are nominated again, joined on the shortlist by Melvine Malard – who netted a brace in our second-half turnaround against Palace – and Kadeisha Buchanan, for her solid displays at the back and a goal against Roma. You can cast your vote to decide our October Player of the Month over on the Chelsea Official App. Remember to keep your eye on our club channels in the coming days to find out who wins!
